notes: REST filters such as since_id become terms in the query string, which supports email, name, location and tags among others.
sortKey defaults to ID. Set it to match whatever the query filters on.
Customer data is protected. An app reading it has to meet Shopify's protected customer data requirements before this call is allowed in production.
REST total_spent is a plain string. Here it is amountSpent, a money object with an amount and a currencyCode, so any code comparing the old string needs changing.
Marketing consent cannot be set here. It has its own mutation, so a REST create that also opted the customer in becomes two calls.
The ID goes inside input, not as a separate argument.
Marketing consent is set by its own mutation, not here.
Only customers without orders can be deleted, so this fails where the REST call would have too, but the failure arrives in userErrors rather than as an HTTP status.
